title: Cohomology vanishing for simultaneous reduction of shifted units
statement: Let ell be prime, W a scheme on which ell is invertible, and D an arbitrary simultaneous derived reduction of extension from integral pro-etale sheaves to constant p-adic module sheaves [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. Write M for comparison pullback of the etale multiplicative-group sheaf. With the displayed derived-category universe choices, T(M[1]) lies in both standard t-structure halves D^{>=-2} and D^{<=-2}. This asserts only cohomology vanishing and no roots identification or boundary normalization.

source.place: Step (3), target paragraph, and step (4), normalization of the unit at shifted comparison units.

proof.text: Use flat-term K-flat resolutions and exact scalar extension to resolve every complex by complexes with monic positive-prime-power multiplication. The multiplication/quotient short exact sequences show that simultaneous ordinary reduction preserves quasi-isomorphisms on this class. Apply the proved cochain resolving-class construction and left-derived uniqueness to make the arbitrary supplied D counit invertible on this class.

Positive-prime-power multiplication on etale units is epi by Kummer exactness. Comparison pullback and p-adic scalar extension preserve epis. On scalar extension of a resolution of comparison units, multiplication is therefore epi on H^0; in every other degree homology is zero.

In the long exact homology sequence of the level multiplication/quotient sequence, the first homology map is epi in every degree and mono in the next degree unless that degree is zero. Mathlib ShortExact.exactAt_X3 gives quotient exactness outside degree minus one. Evaluation and its homology comparison jointly detect these vanishings in the strict-system category.

Transport the degree minus-one bounds through the invertible derived counit and the localized resolving quasi-isomorphism. Use D.triangulated for a shift comparison, shifting the source once to obtain both bounds at minus two.

theorem strict_kummer_cohomology_concentration (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W)) :
    (D.T.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).obj
        ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).IsGE (-2) ∧
    (D.T.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).obj
        ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).IsLE (-2)
